title.en: One printed code, two building tables: which page?
title.zh: 同一个代号、两张建筑表，看哪一页？

description.en: HBT80-1816-110 appears on Electric 80 (60 m³/h, 900 m / 300 m, ≤ 2 cm) and on HBT80-16 (50 m³/h, 120 m horizontal, 360 m height, ≤ 4 cm).

h1.en: One printed code, two building tables: which page?
h1.zh: 同一个代号、两张建筑表，看哪一页？

directAnswer.en: Use the page whose distance and aggregate you measured against. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints HBT80-1816-110 on Electric 80 at 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical and aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). The same code string is on HBT80-16 at 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, horizontal 120 m, delivery height 360 m and aggregate 4 cm and below. High-rise and long-distance pumping is the Electric 80 scenario. Building and commercial placement is the HBT80-16 scenario.
directAnswer.zh: 用你拿来对照过距离和骨料的那一页。邢台河北品锦机械在电动80上印 HBT80-1816-110：110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。同一串代号在 HBT80-16 上是 110 kW、50 m³/h、40 MPa、水平 120 m、输送高度 360 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。高层与长距离泵送是电动80的工况。建筑与商业浇筑是 HBT80-16 的工况。

heading.en: Do not average the two distances
heading.zh: 不要把两段距离取平均

body.en: 900 m is not a midpoint with 120 m. 300 m vertical on Electric 80 is not the 360 m delivery height on HBT80-16. Weights are 6000 kg and 6500 kg. Hoppers are 0.7 m³ on Electric 80; HBT80-16’s table as published here lists pipe 100 / 125 mm and total weight 6500 kg without copying the Electric 80 hopper cell. Quote the URL.
body.zh: 900 m 不是和 120 m 的中间值。电动80的垂直 300 m 也不是 HBT80-16 的输送高度 360 m。重量分别是 6000 kg 和 6500 kg。电动80料斗是 0.7 m³。这里公布的 HBT80-16 表列出管径 100 / 125 mm 和总重 6500 kg，不能把电动80的料斗格抄过去。请引用页面地址。

body.en: The infrastructure page names Electric 80 (HBT80-1816-110) for horizontal distance up to 900 m. That sentence belongs to the Electric 80 table. A 120 m horizontal infrastructure line can be discussed on HBT80-16 only if stone and output also match that page. Remote sites without a 110 kW supply leave both pages for a diesel row.
body.zh: 基建页点名电动80（HBT80-1816-110）的水平距离最高 900 m。这句话属于电动80的表。水平 120 m 的基建管路，只有石子和输送量也对得上时，才在 HBT80-16 上讨论。偏远工地供不起 110 kW，两页都让给柴油行。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Paste one product URL and the stone size. Do not send only the shared code. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请贴一个产品地址和石子粒径。不要只发那个共用代号。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: Both print 110 kW. Output, distance and aggregate still differ.
answer.zh: 两台都印 110 kW。输送量、距离和骨料仍然不同。

answer.en: Both print 40 MPa. Pressure alone does not choose the page.
answer.zh: 两页都印 40 MPa。只有压力不能选定页面。

question.en: Is there a third machine with this code?
question.zh: 这个代号还有第三台吗？

answer.en: These two published pages carry it. HBT8018 is a different code, HBT8018-132S, at 132 kW.
answer.zh: 已公布的是这两页。HBT8018 是另一个代号 HBT8018-132S，电机 132 kW。

alt.zh: HBT80-16 拖泵，邢台印有代号 HBT80-1816-110 的两页之一
